Change order CO-02: Larkspur Ceramics

13 January 2027

What changes

One extra user acceptance testing session, so the three problems found in session 1 can be retested.

Why

Your testers were not at session 2 on 12 January 2027, so UAT-03, UAT-04 and UAT-05 could not be retested in the sessions agreed. One client-side event, so one change order covers all three.

Price

USD 175.00, invoiced when the amendment is signed, due within 14 days of the invoice.

Schedule

One extra test session, on a date we agree.

None. The checks are the ones already agreed.

Approval

This change order is approved only by a signed amendment to our contract. A reply to this email is not approval, and no work starts before the amendment is signed.
